title: Spasticity or Contracture? The Tardieu Catch Lab

hook.en: A stiff limb is not always "high tone". Stretch it slowly, then fast, and the muscle tells you whether the problem is the nervous system or the tissue itself. Do the test yourself.
hook.ur: Akri hui limb hamesha "high tone" nahi hoti. Pehle aahista, phir tez stretch karein, to muscle khud batata hai ke masla nervous system ka hai ya tissue ka. Test khud karke dekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll separate spasticity from rigidity and contracture with the Tardieu method, record R1, R2 and the quality of reaction, and choose a sensible plan for each.
goal.ur: End tak aap Tardieu tareeqe se spasticity ko rigidity aur contracture se alag karenge, R1, R2 aur reaction ki quality likhenge, aur har ek ke liye munasib plan chunenge.

text.en: **Spasticity** is a velocity-dependent increase in the stretch reflex that comes with an upper motor neuron lesion: the **faster** you stretch, the **more** the muscle resists, and past a threshold it "catches". But stiffness has other causes: **rigidity** (basal ganglia: the same resistance at any speed) and **contracture** (the muscle or joint tissue has become short and stiff: resistance appears at the same angle whatever the speed). Treatment differs for each, so the question "why is it stiff?" matters more than "how stiff is it?".
text.ur: **Spasticity** upper motor neuron lesion ke saath stretch reflex ka velocity-dependent izafa hai: jitna **tez** stretch karein, muscle utna **zyada** muqabla karta hai, aur ek threshold ke baad "catch" karta hai. Magar akri hui limb ki doosri wajahein bhi hain: **rigidity** (basal ganglia: har raftaar par ek jaisi muzahimat) aur **contracture** (muscle ya joint tissue chhota aur sakht ho gaya: raftaar jo bhi ho muzahimat usi angle par aati hai). Har ek ka ilaaj alag hai, is liye "kitni akri hai?" se zyada aham sawal "kyun akri hai?" hai.

text.en: A **hydraulic door closer** pushes back harder the faster you shove the door: that is spasticity, a speed-sensitive damper. A **door rusted at the hinge** stops at the same angle however gently or hard you push: that is contracture. A **door dragging on a rough floor** resists the same all the way round, fast or slow: that is rigidity. The Tardieu test is nothing more than pushing the door at two speeds and asking which of the three you have.
text.ur: **Hydraulic door closer** jitna tez dhakka dein utna zyada peechay dhakelta hai: yeh spasticity hai, raftaar se sensitive damper. **Qabzay par zang lagi hui darwaza** jitna aahista ya zor se dhakelein ek hi angle par ruk jata hai: yeh contracture hai. **Khurdari farsh par ghista darwaza** poore raste ek jaisi muzahimat karta hai, tez ya aahista: yeh rigidity hai. Tardieu test bas darwazay ko do raftaaron par dhakelna hai aur poochna ke teenon mein se kaunsa hai.

intro.en: Pick a muscle type and a stretch speed, then press "Stretch the muscle". The dot rides the resistance curve. Start with Spasticity at V1 (slow: free, full range), then V2, then V3: the catch (R1) jumps EARLIER as you go faster. Now try Fixed contracture and Rigidity and see that changing the speed changes nothing.
intro.ur: Muscle ki qisam aur stretch ki raftaar chunein, phir "Muscle stretch karein" dabayein. Dot muzahimat ke curve par chalta hai. Spasticity V1 (aahista: azad, poori range) se shuru karein, phir V2, phir V3: tez karte hi catch (R1) JALDI aata hai. Ab Fixed contracture aur Rigidity try karein aur dekhein ke raftaar badalne se kuch nahi badalta.

question.en: A patient's elbow flexors move freely through the whole range when stretched slowly, but catch at 40% of the range when stretched fast. What is the likeliest cause of the stiffness?
question.ur: Mareez ke elbow flexors aahista stretch par poori range mein azad hain, magar tez stretch par range ke 40% par catch karte hain. Akarhne ki sab se mumkin wajah kya hai?

text.en: Spasticity (a velocity-dependent stretch reflex)
text.ur: Spasticity (velocity-dependent stretch reflex)

feedback.en: Yes — full range when slow plus an early catch when fast is the signature of spasticity, and a long R2 − R1 shows that the neural component is large.
feedback.ur: Haan — aahista par poori range aur tez par jaldi catch spasticity ki pehchan hai, aur lamba R2 − R1 batata hai ke neural hissa bara hai.

text.en: A fixed contracture
text.ur: Fixed contracture

feedback.en: A contracture limits the range even when you go slowly, and speed makes no difference. Here the slow range is full.
feedback.ur: Contracture aahista karne par bhi range ko mehdood karta hai aur raftaar se farq nahi padta. Yahan aahista range poori hai.

text.en: Parkinsonian rigidity
text.ur: Parkinsonian rigidity

feedback.en: Rigidity resists equally at all speeds and has no catch.
feedback.ur: Rigidity har raftaar par ek jaisi muzahimat karti hai aur catch nahi hota.

hint.en: Compare the slow and fast stretch: what changes?
hint.ur: Aahista aur tez stretch ka muqabla karein: kya badalta hai?

text.en: **The Tardieu method** (and its modified form) uses three speeds. **V1** is as slow as you can go (slower than the limb's own fall under gravity): at its end you measure **R2**, the full passive range of motion, which reflects the **muscle length**. **V2** is the speed of the limb falling under gravity. **V3** is as fast as possible (faster than gravity): you record **R1**, the angle of the **catch**, and **X**, the **quality of the reaction** (0 = no resistance, 1 = slight resistance, 2 = a clear catch then release, 3 = fatigable clonus under 10 seconds, 4 = unfatigable clonus, 5 = the joint will not move). The gap **R2 − R1** is the **dynamic (neural) component**; a small R2 is the **non-neural (fixed) component**.
text.ur: **Tardieu tareeqa** (aur uski modified shakal) teen raftaar istemal karta hai. **V1** jitna aahista ho sake (limb ke apne gravity se girne se bhi aahista): iske aakhir mein aap **R2**, poori passive range of motion, naapte hain, jo **muscle ki lambai** dikhati hai. **V2** gravity se girte limb ki raftaar. **V3** jitna tez ho sake (gravity se tez): yahan aap **R1**, **catch** ka angle, aur **X**, **reaction ki quality** likhte hain (0 = muzahimat nahi, 1 = halki muzahimat, 2 = saaf catch phir release, 3 = thakne wala clonus 10 second se kam, 4 = na thakne wala clonus, 5 = joint hilta nahi). **R2 − R1** ka farq **dynamic (neural) hissa** hai; chhota R2 **non-neural (fixed) hissa** hai.

question.en: A child's calf muscle reaches only 15° of dorsiflexion even at the slowest speed, and fast stretches do not change that angle. What does this show?
question.ur: Bachay ka calf muscle sab se aahista raftaar par bhi sirf 15° dorsiflexion tak pohanchta hai, aur tez stretch se yeh angle nahi badalta. Yeh kya dikhata hai?

text.en: A fixed contracture: the problem is tissue length, not a reflex
text.ur: Fixed contracture: masla tissue ki lambai ka hai, reflex ka nahi

feedback.en: Yes — a short R2 that does not depend on speed means non-neural shortening. Slowing down will not release a muscle that is simply short.
feedback.ur: Haan — chhota R2 jo raftaar par depend nahi karta non-neural shortening hai. Aahista karne se woh muscle nahi khulta jo bas chhota ho chuka hai.

text.en: Severe spasticity that needs tone-reducing drugs first
text.ur: Shadeed spasticity jis ke liye pehle tone kam karne wali dawaiyan chahiye

feedback.en: With spasticity the slow range is full. Here even the slow range is short.
feedback.ur: Spasticity mein aahista range poori hoti hai. Yahan aahista range bhi chhoti hai.

text.en: Normal muscle length with high tone
text.ur: Normal muscle length aur high tone

feedback.en: Normal length would give a full slow range.
feedback.ur: Normal lambai mein aahista range poori hoti.

title.ur: Kaunsa scale kis sawal ke liye?

rows.en: Resistance to a passive stretch, graded 0 to 4
rows.ur: Passive stretch par muzahimat, 0 se 4 grade

rows.en: Quick and familiar, but it does not control velocity and cannot tell spasticity from contracture; reliability varies by muscle
rows.ur: Tez aur jana pehchana, magar raftaar control nahi karta aur spasticity ko contracture se alag nahi kar sakta; reliability muscle ke hisaab se badalti hai

rows.en: Catch angle (R1), full range (R2) and quality (X) at set speeds
rows.ur: Muqarrar raftaar par catch angle (R1), poori range (R2) aur quality (X)

rows.en: Separates neural from non-neural stiffness, matches how spasticity is defined; needs training, a goniometer and standard speeds
rows.ur: Neural ko non-neural akrahat se alag karta hai, spasticity ki tareef se milta hai; training, goniometer aur muqarrar raftaar chahiye

rows.en: Muscle length or the fixed component
rows.ur: Muscle ki lambai ya fixed hissa

rows.en: Easy to repeat and track over time; says nothing about the reflex component
rows.ur: Dohrana aur waqt ke saath track karna asaan; reflex hisse ke bare mein kuch nahi batata

text.en: **Calling every stiff limb "spastic" and stretching it fast.** Quick, forceful stretches drive the very reflex you hope to relax and hurt the patient. Another trap is **measuring inconsistently**: spasticity changes with posture, temperature, effort, pain, bladder fullness and time of day, so compare the same muscle, the same position and ideally the same time. And a third: **assuming spasticity is always bad**. Some patients use their extensor tone to stand or walk, and removing it blindly can leave them unable to do either.
text.ur: **Har akri hui limb ko "spastic" kehna aur tez stretch karna.** Tez, zorawar stretch usi reflex ko barhata hai jise aap dheela karna chahte hain aur mareez ko takleef deta hai. Doosra jaal: **be-qaida naap**: spasticity posture, temperature, koshish, dard, bhare bladder aur din ke waqt ke saath badalti hai, is liye wahi muscle, wahi position aur behtar hai ke wahi waqt muqabla karein. Teesra: **yeh samajhna ke spasticity hamesha buri hai**. Kuch mareez khare hone ya chalne ke liye apna extensor tone istemal karte hain, aur bina soche use hatane se woh dono kaam nahi kar paate.

steps.title: Standardise the set-up
steps.detail: Same muscle, same starting position (for the gastrocnemius: knee straight), same time of day, warm room, relaxed patient, bladder emptied. || Set-up ko muqarrar karein

steps.title: Do V1 first to find R2
steps.detail: Move the joint as slowly as you can to the end of the range and read the angle with a goniometer: this is the muscle length. || Pehle V1 se R2 dhoondein

steps.title: Then V3 for R1 and X
steps.detail: Stretch as fast as you can, note the angle of the catch (R1) and grade the reaction 0 to 5. Repeat V2 if you need the gravity-speed response. || Phir V3 se R1 aur X

steps.title: Repeat and record
steps.detail: Three repetitions per speed; write the speeds, the angles from the position of least stretch, X, and R2 − R1. || Dohrayein aur likhein

steps.title: Link the numbers to the plan
steps.detail: A large R2 − R1 is mostly neural (tone management); a small R2 with little R2 − R1 is mostly fixed shortening (stretch, casting, orthoses); both = treat both. || Numbers ko plan se jorein

text.en: **Turn the numbers into goals.** "Right gastrocnemius: R2 = 10° dorsiflexion (short), R1 = 5° at V3, X = 2. Mixed contracture and spasticity. Plan: serial casting or night splint to restore R2; botulinum toxin discussion with the doctor if the catch interferes with stance; strengthening of the dorsiflexors; reassess in 6 weeks." A good plan also says what to leave alone: spasticity that helps the patient stand.
text.ur: **Numbers ko goals mein badlein.** "Right gastrocnemius: R2 = 10° dorsiflexion (chhota), R1 = 5° V3 par, X = 2. Mixed contracture aur spasticity. Plan: R2 behal karne ke liye serial casting ya raat ka splint; agar catch stance mein rukawat dale to doctor se botulinum toxin par baat; dorsiflexors ki strengthening; 6 hafte mein dobara naap." Achha plan yeh bhi batata hai ke kya chhoona nahi hai: woh spasticity jo mareez ko khara hone mein madad deti hai.

text.en: The modified Tardieu scale separates the reflex component from the fixed component better than the Ashworth scales, and its reliability in children with cerebral palsy is acceptable when raters are trained to use standard velocities and positions. Strength training does **not** increase spasticity in people after stroke: a systematic review found that strengthening improved strength and activity without increasing tone, so you can strengthen a spastic limb.
text.ur: Modified Tardieu scale reflex hisse ko fixed hisse se Ashworth scales se behtar alag karta hai, aur cerebral palsy ke bachon mein iski reliability munasib hai jab raters ko muqarrar raftaar aur positions istemal karna sikhaya gaya ho. Stroke ke baad logon mein strength training spasticity ko **nahi** barhati: ek systematic review mein paya gaya ke strengthening ne tone barhaye baghair taqat aur activity behtar ki, is liye aap spastic limb ko strong kar sakte hain.

text.en: **A sudden increase in tone in a patient who was stable is a message, not a diagnosis.** Look for a **noxious trigger**: a urine infection, a full bladder or bowel, a pressure injury, an ingrown toenail, tight clothes or a catheter, a new fracture or an infection. Rule out a **new neurological event** (a new stroke, spinal cord compression). In spinal cord injury at T6 or above, a rise in tone with a pounding headache and flushing may be **autonomic dysreflexia**, which is an emergency. Never force a painful stretch.
text.ur: **Pehle se stable mareez mein tone ka achanak barhna ek paigham hai, tashkhees nahi.** **Takleef dene wala trigger** dhoondein: peshab ka infection, bhara bladder ya bowel, pressure injury, andar ki taraf barhta nakhun, tang kapray ya catheter, naya fracture ya infection. **Naye neurological waqiye** (naya stroke, spinal cord compression) ko rule out karein. T6 ya upar spinal cord injury mein tone ka barhna aur dhamaake wala sar dard aur chehra laal **autonomic dysreflexia** ho sakta hai, jo emergency hai. Dard wala stretch kabhi zabardasti na karein.

prompt.en: Neural (spasticity) or non-neural (contracture)? Sort the finding.
prompt.ur: Neural (spasticity) ya non-neural (contracture)? Finding sort karein.

text.en: The catch comes earlier as the stretch gets faster
text.ur: Stretch jitna tez, catch utna jaldi

why.en: Speed-dependence is the definition of spasticity.
why.ur: Raftaar par depend karna spasticity ki tareef hai.

text.en: Clonus (rhythmic beats) when the muscle is stretched and held
text.ur: Muscle ko stretch kar ke rokne par clonus (rhythmic jhatkay)

why.en: Clonus is a reflex phenomenon and a sign of the UMN syndrome.
why.ur: Clonus reflex ka mazhar aur UMN syndrome ki alamat hai.

text.en: Reduced range even at the slowest speed, with a hard end feel
text.ur: Sab se aahista raftaar par bhi range kam aur sakht end feel

why.en: The tissue itself is short; slow stretching cannot lengthen it quickly.
why.ur: Tissue khud chhota hai; aahista stretch bhi use jaldi lamba nahi kar sakta.

text.en: The same stiff end angle at V1, V2 and V3
text.ur: V1, V2 aur V3 par ek hi akra hua aakhri angle

why.en: No change with speed means no reflex contribution to the limit.
why.ur: Raftaar se farq nahi, yaani range ki had mein reflex ka hissa nahi.

question.en: Why does the catch happen EARLIER when the stretch is faster?
question.ur: Stretch tez ho to catch JALDI kyun aata hai?

answer.en: Muscle spindles measure both the length and the **speed** of stretch. After an upper motor neuron lesion, the spinal reflex loop has lost its brake from the brain, so the reflex threshold falls. A fast stretch drives the spindle's speed signal far above that low threshold early in the range, while a slow stretch stays below it until much later or never. The catch angle therefore moves toward the start as speed rises.
answer.ur: Muscle spindles stretch ki lambai aur **raftaar** dono naapte hain. Upper motor neuron lesion ke baad spinal reflex loop dimagh ki brake kho deta hai, is liye reflex ki threshold gir jati hai. Tez stretch range ke shuru mein hi spindle ke speed signal ko us kam threshold se kahin upar le jata hai, jabke aahista stretch bahut baad tak ya hamesha uske neechay rehta hai. Is liye raftaar barhne par catch ka angle shuru ki taraf khisakta hai.

question.en: Why is the Modified Ashworth Scale limited for deciding between tone management and stretching?
question.ur: Tone management aur stretching ke darmiyan faisla karne ke liye Modified Ashworth Scale mehdood kyun hai?

text.en: It is too complex to repeat
text.ur: Yeh dohrane ke liye bohat peecheeda hai

feedback.en: It is actually simple and quick. That is why it is popular.
feedback.ur: Yeh dar asal saada aur tez hai. Isi liye mashhoor hai.

text.en: It does not control the speed and cannot tell reflex resistance from soft-tissue stiffness
text.ur: Yeh raftaar control nahi karta aur reflex muzahimat ko soft-tissue akrahat se alag nahi kar sakta

feedback.en: Yes — one number mixes both causes, so it cannot say whether tone or length is the main problem.
feedback.ur: Haan — ek number dono wajahon ko mila deta hai, is liye nahi bata sakta ke tone ya lambai asal masla hai.

text.en: It can only be used on the upper limb
text.ur: Yeh sirf upper limb par istemal ho sakta hai

feedback.en: It can be used in both limbs; the limit is conceptual, not anatomical.
feedback.ur: Yeh dono limbs par istemal ho sakta hai; had tasawwur ki hai, anatomy ki nahi.

summary.en: Spasticity is velocity-dependent: slow gives full range, fast gives an early catch. Rigidity resists equally at all speeds; contracture stops at the same angle at any speed.
summary.ur: Spasticity velocity-dependent hai: aahista par poori range, tez par jaldi catch. Rigidity har raftaar par ek jaisi muzahimat karti hai; contracture har raftaar par ek hi angle par rukta hai.

summary.en: Tardieu: R2 at the slowest speed is the muscle length, R1 at the fastest is the catch, X grades the reaction, and R2 − R1 is the neural part.
summary.ur: Tardieu: sab se aahista raftaar par R2 muscle ki lambai, sab se tez par R1 catch, X reaction ko grade karta hai, aur R2 − R1 neural hissa hai.

summary.en: Standardise the measurement, treat the cause (tone versus length), strengthen without fear, and hunt for a trigger when tone suddenly rises.
summary.ur: Naap ko muqarrar karein, wajah (tone ya lambai) ka ilaaj karein, bila dar strengthening karein, aur tone achanak barhe to trigger dhoondein.

back.en: A velocity-dependent increase in the tonic stretch reflex (resistance rises with speed), part of the upper motor neuron syndrome.
back.ur: Tonic stretch reflex ka velocity-dependent izafa (raftaar ke saath muzahimat barhti hai), upper motor neuron syndrome ka hissa.

front.en: What do R1 and R2 mean in the Tardieu method?
front.ur: Tardieu tareeqe mein R1 aur R2 ka kya matlab hai?

back.en: R1 = the angle of the catch at fast stretch; R2 = the full passive range at the slowest stretch. R2 − R1 is the neural component.
back.ur: R1 = tez stretch par catch ka angle; R2 = sab se aahista stretch par poori passive range. R2 − R1 neural hissa hai.

front.en: How does rigidity differ from spasticity on a stretch test?
front.ur: Stretch test par rigidity spasticity se kaise alag hai?

back.en: Rigidity resists equally at all speeds with no catch; spasticity is velocity-dependent with a catch.
back.ur: Rigidity har raftaar par ek jaisi muzahimat karti hai aur catch nahi hota; spasticity velocity-dependent hai aur catch hota hai.

front.en: What does a short R2 that does not change with speed suggest?
front.ur: Chhota R2 jo raftaar se nahi badalta, kya dikhata hai?

back.en: A fixed (non-neural) contracture: tissue shortening needing stretch, casting, orthoses or surgery.
back.ur: Fixed (non-neural) contracture: tissue ka chhota hona jis ke liye stretch, casting, orthoses ya surgery chahiye.

note.en: The bedside tone exam that comes before the Tardieu method.
note.ur: Bedside tone exam jo Tardieu tareeqe se pehle aata hai.

note.en: Why the stretch reflex is released after an upper motor neuron lesion.
note.ur: Upper motor neuron lesion ke baad stretch reflex kyun azad ho jata hai.

note.en: The management guide where Tardieu measures are used in practice.
note.ur: Management guide jahan Tardieu naap amli taur par istemal hote hain.
